origin.description: Coerce to a regular zoo series, keeping or setting the frequency.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An object. A ts uses the ts method. A zoo uses the zoo method.

arguments.name: frequency
arguments.text: Observations per unit of time. NULL keeps or infers the frequency.
Further arguments. For a ts they are passed to zooreg. For other objects the default method passes them to as.zoo.

origin.details: as.zooreg.ts is the same function as as.zoo.ts: zooreg of the core data with the tsp start, end, and frequency, unless frequency is overridden. as.zooreg.zoo sets frequency when it is not NULL. When it is NULL, a plain zoo tries to infer a frequency; if none is found it warns and rebuilds the series with zooreg(coredata(x)), which discards the old index.
origin.example:
x <- as.zooreg(ts(1:4, start = 2000, frequency = 4), calendar = FALSE)
cat(paste(coredata(x), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
cat(paste(sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(index(x))), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
cat(frequency(x), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Coerce to a regular zoo series, keeping or setting the frequency.
translation.usage: as_zooreg(x, frequency=None, calendar=True, order_by=None, deltat=None, ts_eps=None)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A Ts, a Zoo, or an object as_zoo accepts.

arguments.name: frequency
arguments.text: When set on a Zoo, replaces the frequency. When omitted, a regular series keeps its frequency and a plain series infers one.

arguments.name: calendar
arguments.text: Passed through when x is a Ts.

translation.details: A Ts is handed to zooreg with its start, end, and frequency. A Zoo with a new frequency checks that the index step times the frequency is an integer. The zooreg method reports the all.equal failure in full; the zoo method reports freqOK is not TRUE. If no frequency can be inferred, the warning is that x does not have an underlying regularity, and the data are placed on 1, 2, 3, ... with frequency 1.
translation.example:
from zoo.as_zoo import Ts, as_zooreg
import numpy as np
x = as_zooreg(Ts(np.arange(1, 5), start=2000, frequency=4), calendar=False)
print(" ".join(str(int(v)) for v in np.asarray(x.data).reshape(-1)))
print(" ".join(f"{float(v):.2f}" for v in np.asarray(x.index, dtype=float)))
print(int(x.frequency))
